---

---

**What's the problem you're trying to solve?**
<!-- The pain point, not the solution. e.g. "As a bank investor, I can't see credit-cost trend." -->

**What would the ideal feature look like?**
<!-- Describe it as a user, not a coder. Sketch / mock-up welcome. -->

**Which part of the app would it live in?**
<!-- e.g. Equity Dashboard → the Bank view, or Holdings tab, or a new tab. -->

**Any references?**
<!-- Books, blogs, a public dashboard you like — anything that shows what you mean. -->
